findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stamp_check_email_domain, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, mend_repair_json, mend_query_json, doorman_check_ai_bot_access · Private data: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, tick_next_runs, mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json, swatch_make_scale, meridian_convert_time, doorman_check_ai_bot_access · Public sink: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record, tick_next_runs, mend_query_json, meridian_convert_time, notary_check_packages · Destructive: deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, swatch_check_contrast.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stamp_check_email_domain, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, mend_repair_json, mend_query_json, doorman_check_ai_bot_access · Private data: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, tick_next_runs, mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json, swatch_make_scale, meridian_convert_time, doorman_check_ai_bot_access · Public sink: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record, tick_next_runs, mend_query_json, meridian_convert_time, notary_check_packages · Destructive: deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, swatch_check_contrast

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
